[Approval Notes · Quality Defect Handling Form TK-20261011-6407]
Submitter: Process Quality Engineer Submission Date: 2026-11-13 15:39 Approver: Equipment Engineer DEV-3406 Person in charge

1. Factual description
Under item SO-20261115-899861, a total of 420 items were found in B-88702. During the first piece and inspection of the No. 3 production line S-951, flange end face flatness was found to be exceedingly deviating. Among 30 samples sampled, 11 had flatness within the 0.12~0.18mm range, with a drawing tolerance upper limit of 0.05mm. Coordinate re-measurement data are attached, with an error rate of 36.7%. At the same time, visual inspection reveals no surface abnormalities such as scratches, rust, or burrs; Assembly trial assembly with 5 sets of holes matched normally and without interference; Both the material warranty certificate and spectral re-inspection are qualified.

II. Determination Criteria (This form is executed, applicable item by item)
1) Defect categories are classified by "deviation type with the highest proportion of quantity": ≥30% of the number of dimensional deviations is classified as dimensional deviation; The number of abnormal surface and assembly pieces is 0, and no management is involved.
2) Severity level: If the single deviation exceeds the tolerance limit by 2 times or more and affects subsequent assembly functions, the grade is 3 (critical); Exceeding the limit but not reaching twice the limit, and restoring functionality after repair, is classified as Level 2 (Serious); Only affects appearance by 0 levels; Classified as one level between mild and severe. The maximum deviation in this batch is 0.18mm, which is 3.6 times the upper limit, resulting in 2 out of 5 trial sets requiring gaskets to be fastened.
3) Scrapping judgment: If the category is dimensional deviation with severity level 2 or above, and the estimated repair time exceeds 40% of the original value of a single piece, it will be declared as direct scrapping; Rework can be restored and costs below 40%, so rework or concession is accepted. This batch of rework requires full-face re-milling and recoating, with labor time estimated at about 65% of the original value per piece.

3. Others
DEV-1550 The No. 4 air compressor tripped once yesterday afternoon and has been reported for repair, unrelated to this case. Please approve. Supplementary conclusion: this case does not amount to "Dimensional out of tolerance".

state: Customer complaint original text recap (C-62908 After-sales work order TK-20261024-1121 forwarded): Your company installed 200 drive shaft assemblies (SO-20261026-261434) in B-53014, and after 300 hours of operation, 6 units experienced abnormal noises and broke off. Our company disassembled 3 machines, with the fracture located at the root of the spline, showing a brittle cleavage morphology with no obvious plastic deformation; The attached third-party metallographic report shows grain size grade 3, decarburization layer 0.05mm (our requirement is ≤0.10mm), hardness 52HRC, while the drawings require 58-62HRC, indicating insufficient heat treatment quenching with surface decarburization. Dimensional re-measurement of spline span bar spacing and shaft diameter are all within tolerance; Assembly dimension chain verification shows no abnormalities; No electrical components. According to our company's defect classification criteria: material composition, metallographic structure, hardness, and heat treatment layer depth all fall under material or heat treatment categories, with higher priority than size and assembly. Scrapping Standards: For safety components involving brittle fracture or material performance substandard, no rework or concession will be accepted; the entire batch will be scrapped. Severity level: 0 points for general appearance defects, 1 point for minor repairs, 2 points for batch functional failure, and 3 points for breakage resulting in personal injury or major equipment safety accidents. This batch has experienced a complete machine breakage; the highest grade is used. Inventory of 480 units has been frozen. Please respond within 48 hours. Supplementary conclusion: this case amounts to "Material or heat-treatment defect".

All 37 units passed the power-on test, with insulation withstand voltage of 1500V and no breakdown, grounding resistance of 0.06Ω, thus not involved in electrical safety matters; Cabinet dimensions and sheet metal hole positions are re-tested and qualified, and material reports are complete with the goods. This batch has no ablation and can be repaired as a whole, so it will not be scrapped. state: Internal email body: Everyone, please update progress on the recent frequent uninstallation of the S-000 air compressor unit. Monitoring data shows exhaust temperature at 88°C, not reaching 105°C high-temperature shutdown line; Lubricating oil analysis iron spectral readings are 42 ppm, in the concern zone (concern area 40-60 ppm), and have not yet entered the alarm zone above 60 ppm. According to current maintenance determination rules: if the exhaust temperature reaches 105°C or if the safety valve starts, obvious leakage, or abnormal vibration (≥11.2mm/s), the machine must be stopped immediately; If the iron spectrum reading is within the focus area and the exhaust temperature has not exceeded the limit, it indicates early deterioration and predictive maintenance should be arranged (replacing oil and retesting bearing trends), and downgrading should not be done to maintenance-free maintenance; Only when Tiepu enters the alarm zone above 60ppm or the exhaust temperature exceeds 105°C is it switched to fault repair; emergency repair is only triggered when safety risks arise. Shutdown risk score: Tiepu deducts 1 point for the attention area, 0 points for exhaust temperature not exceeding limits, 0 points for units with dual units and standby units, totaling 1 point; If 0 is low, 1 is medium, 2 is high, and 3 or above is extremely high, it is classified as moderate. Note: 2026-11-17 In the afternoon 14:15, the next quarter's spare parts budget review will be held in Conference Room 3. Equipment engineers are requested to attend on time. This matter is unrelated to this decision. Supplementary conclusion: this case does not amount to "Predictive maintenance".
